comment: The voice-over as data, written by the lead. One phrase per spoken sentence or breath group. `at` is where the phrase starts in the film, as a position in bars and beats counted from zero like shots.json (bar 2, beat 1 is the second beat of the third bar). The voice step writes audio/voice/<id>.wav and data/voice-words.json from this file; bun run score places each phrase at its position, ducks the music under it and writes data/lyrics.json for the captions.

phrases.text: Boiling water on green leaves | turns the cup bitter.
Let the kettle rest | a minute after the boil.
Three minutes, | then lift them out.
Mind the water, | mind the time.
